messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
103 ಅವನು ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ವಸ್ತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಆಹಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, 104 ಆದರೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಧೈರ್ಯ, 105 ಮತ್ತು ಅವನ ಜನ್ಮಸ್ಥಳ ಫೆಲ್ಟ್ರೋ ಮತ್ತು ಫೆಲ್ಟ್ರೋ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|----------------------------|--------| | Questi | demonstrative pronoun, 3rd sg. male – the subject | ಅವನು | “he” | OK | | non | negation particle | — (negation encoded in verb) | — | UNNECESSARY | | ciberà | future “will feed / will take” | ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ | “will not take/consume” | OK | | terra | “land”, physical earth | ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ | “in/on the land” | OK | | né | coordinating “nor” (negative coordination) | — (implicit in the two “‑ಲ್ಲಿಯೂ” forms) | — | UNNECESSARY | | peltro | “goods”, material wealth | ವಸ್ತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೂ | “in/on goods” | OK | | ma | contrastive “but” | ಆದರೆ | “but” | OK | | sapïenza | “wisdom” (intellectual virtue) | ಜ್ಞಾನ | “wisdom” | OK | | amore | “love” (affective virtue) | ಪ್ರೀತಿ | “love” | OK | | e (between *amore* and *virtute*) | coordinating “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | virtute | “valor / virtue” (courageous excellence) | ಧೈರ್ಯ | “valor” | OK | | e (linking line 104 to line 105) | coordinating “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | sua | possessive adjective “his” | ಅವನ | “his” | OK | | nazion | “birthplace / nation” | ಜನ್ಮಸ್ಥಳ | “birthplace” | OK | | sarà | future copula “shall be” | ಇರುತ್ತದೆ | “shall be / will be” | OK | | tra | preposition “between” | ನಡುವೆ | “between” | OK | | feltro (first) | proper noun – place name | ಫೆಲ್ಟ್ರೋ | “Feltro” | OK | | e (between the two *feltro*) | coordinating “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | feltro (second) | proper noun – place name | ಫೆಲ್ಟ್ರೋ | “Feltro” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **non** – marked **UNNECESSARY** (negation is expressed within the verb *ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ*; a separate particle is not required in Kannada). - **né** – marked **UNNECESSARY** (the negative coordination is conveyed by the two “‑ಲ್ಲಿಯೂ” forms; no explicit “nor” is needed).
All other source words are correctly rendered with appropriate grammatical agreement and meaning.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
